description.label: Description
description.description: Optional summary of the permission's purpose.
description.help: Enter a short explanation of what the permission is intended to grant.

class_name.label: Class
class_name.description: Entity class to which the permission applies.
class_name.help: Enter the fully qualified class name that the permission targets.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: JSON constraint domain applied by the permission.
domain.help: Enter the JSON domain that limits which objects are accessible.

object_id.label: Object
object_id.description: Identifier of the object targeted by the permission.
object_id.help: Enter the object identifier when the permission applies to one specific object.

rights.label: Rights
rights.description: Binary mask of the granted access rights.
rights.help:
Permissions are set by using a binary mask, bits meaning:
bit 0 (2^0 = 1): create
bit 1 (2^1 = 2): read
bit 2 (2^2 = 4): write
bit 3 (2^3 = 8): delete
bit 4 (2^4 = 16): manage

Ex.: To grant read and write permissions, we need to set bits 1 and 2,
 so field value would be 6 (2^1+2^2).

group_id.label: Group
group_id.description: Group to which the permission belongs.
group_id.help: Select the group that receives the permission.

user_id.label: User
user_id.description: User to whom the permission applies.
user_id.help: Select the user who receives the permission.

rights_txt.label: Rights
rights_txt.description: Text representation of the granted rights.
rights_txt.help: This value is calculated automatically from the rights mask.
